name: SDSS J1522+2535 (Webb)
blurb: SDSS J1522+2535, a galaxy cluster magnifying the distant galaxy MRG-S1522, seen by Webb.
label: mrgs1522-webb
story: The gravity of this foreground galaxy cluster magnifies a far more distant galaxy that had already stopped making stars. Webb looked closely to learn how, and how quickly, that galaxy's star formation shut down.

claims.text: MRG-S1522 is a lensed quiescent galaxy whose lens is the cluster SDSSJ1522+2535
MRG stands for Magnified Red Galaxy
Webb program 4903 studies gravitationally lensed quiescent galaxies
The program aims to learn how and how quickly star formation ended
